description: Saudi overtime on SAR 6,000 basic plus SAR 3,000 allowances is SAR 50 an hour, not SAR 37.50. Get UAE, Saudi and US overtime pay from your real salary. Web page: https://calcbright.com/overtime-calculator

basic.description: Basic monthly salary Basic salary only, before housing, transport and other allowances.

dayHours.description: Normal hours a day (hrs) Usually 8; 6 for Muslim workers in Ramadan in Saudi Arabia, 2 fewer in the UAE.

otDay.description: Overtime hours (hrs) Hours beyond your normal hours in the period.

otNight.description: Of which 10 pm – 4 am (hrs) Night overtime earns +50% instead of +25% (not for shift workers).

restDay.description: Hours worked on rest days / holidays (hrs) UAE: paid +50% unless you get a substitute day off. Saudi Arabia: all such hours are overtime.

total.description: Total monthly wage Basic plus fixed allowances – Saudi law pays the full hourly wage plus 50% of the basic.
